scope_limits: All unrecorded training policy trees are not independently replayed: one predeclared minimum-ID whole policy witness per job/method and all saved tracegroups are checked, plus complete stored training metric arithmetic.

Forecast arithmetic is independently recomputed at fixed state slots and training witnesses, not every recorded actual/inner state. Remaining decisions are audited against recorded estimates and the frozen gate.

Independent numerical algorithms and source hashes are not independent human peer review, new blind market evidence, conditional forecast calibration, action benefit certainty or full-H risk guarantees.

The training calendar suffix law and fixed-quantity forecast continuation are model assumptions. The implemented repeated gate is adaptive; numerical agreement does not eliminate continuation approximation.
